verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own Exports API. You choose an export type and a date range, and the types cover customers, customer screening, screening and monitoring cases, profiles, payment-screening cases, transaction-monitoring cases and alerts, and transactions. Transaction data is explicitly exportable as CSV, and case audit trails are retrievable via an API described in a public OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. The download URL expires after only 5 seconds, and the evidence does not state the file format for most export types or describe any account exit or offboarding process. missing for 10: documented open file formats for all export types beyond transaction CSV, evidence that exports cover all account data (e.g. configurations, risk-score settings, users), a documented data-portability or offboarding and deletion process, hands-on corroboration of a full export.
